name: Player monster
notes: The monster the human picked on the menu (its species comes from 'chosen'). The D-pad walks in 8 directions (diagonals as fast as straight). A = move 1, B = move 2, R = move 3, each on a single press (a move still charging does nothing). A charged move always goes off and uses its charge, even with no monster in reach (aiming is the player's job): its effect plays straight ahead. Moves recharge on their own timers; move 2 unlocks at level 4 and move 3 at level 7. It levels up to level 25. HP starts at 60 (a species' hp_bonus adds to it: Furrbit starts with 72); each level adds 8 to the max and refills the HP to full (a reward for fighting instead of running). Sounds: B before move 2 unlocks, or R before move 3 unlocks, buzzes (sfx_error); a move that reaches no monster, or one that misses, whiffs (sfx_miss); a hit plays its type's hit sound (game.battle.player_hit_sounds), plus a ping when it is super effective. Walking makes it harder to hit: when it walked during the last 0.1 s (6 ticks) before a wild monster or the Alpha uses a move, that move's accuracy drops 20 points (dodge_walk), and 50 when on one of those ticks it walked diagonally away from the attacker on both axes (dodge_away 30 more; e.g. the attacker on the right and a bit lower, walking left and up). Only moves that can miss: a 95% move hits 95% standing still, 75% walking, 45% walking diagonally away; ground zones (Ember, Acid, Toxic, Rock Slide) and status-only moves (Growl, Phase) never miss. When a wild monster's move hurts it, it flashes white and the screen shakes a tiny bit (1 pixel, at random up, down and sideways, for 1/6 s), so you feel every hit. Floor items it walks into boost it for the rest of the run: Swift Feather +10% speed (boost_speed), Power Gem +10% damage (boost_power), Aim Charm 5% fewer misses (boost_aim), Mist Orb wild monsters miss it 10% more (boost_dodge), Quick Hourglass moves recharge 10% faster (boost_charge). Its run clock also raises the sleeping Alpha's level by 1 each whole minute (boss_level, 4 up to 14) until all 24 wild monsters have fainted. In its home world (the run's world is its own type: a Fire monster on Ember Crater) it hits 10% harder, walks 10% faster and its moves recharge 10% sooner for the whole run, on top of the floor items; when the run starts, +10% POWER, +10% SPEED and -10% RECHARGE float up over it one after the other (cyan, with the item chime). START pauses. When its HP runs out it blinks away and the run ends. A shiny monster (its slot of 'shiny' is set: one more every 5 different runs won) shimmers through the rainbow in every animation (its moves' effects keep their colors), its moves hit 10% harder (power 100% becomes 110%, before the boosts) and it starts the run with 20% more HP (60 becomes 72; Furrbit's 72 becomes 86). When a wild monster's move hurts a shiny one it blinks red 3 times, like the wild monsters do, instead of the white flash, so the hit shows over the rainbow.
